# Working on Acme Groove

Acme Groove is a static practice room. Read this before changing anything.

## How work is run

Milestones are outcomes. Each phase file names its milestone, and
`npm run roadmap:check` keeps the roadmap honest. This prose is the project's
own and adopt must keep every byte of it.

## Commands

```bash
npm run check:all   # the gate
```
